allow.docs: This action allows the given deep sleep component to enter deep sleep, after previously being prevented.

sleep_duration.docs:
The time duration to stay in deep sleep mode. If a template is used, it should return a value in milliseconds.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#esp32-can-sleep-until-a-specific-time-of-day)*

time_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the time component to use for the `until` option. Only on ESP32.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#esp32-can-sleep-until-a-specific-time-of-day)*

until.docs:
**string**: The time of day to wake up. Only on ESP32.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#esp32-can-sleep-until-a-specific-time-of-day)*

enter.docs: This action makes the given deep sleep component enter deep sleep immediately.

prevent.docs: This action prevents the given deep sleep component from entering deep sleep. Useful for keeping the ESP active during data transfer or OTA updating (See note below for more information).

ANY_LOW.docs: wake up when any selected pin is LOW (ESP32‑C5/C6/C61/H2/P4/S2/S3 only)

ALL_LOW.docs: wake up when all selected pins are LOW (ESP32 only)

ANY_HIGH.docs: wake up when any selected pin is HIGH

mode.docs:
The mode to use for the wakeup source. Must be one of:

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

on_wake.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to run when this specific pin woke the device from deep sleep. See [`on_wake` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#on_wake-trigger).

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin to wake up on.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

pins.docs:
**list**: The pins to wake up on. Each entry is either a [Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema) directly, or a mapping of:

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

esp32_ext1_wakeup.docs:
Use the EXT1 wakeup source of the ESP32 to wake from deep sleep to wake up on multiple pins. This cannot be used together with wakeup pin.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

on_wake.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to run when the device boots after waking from deep sleep. Only on ESP32, ESP8266 and BK72xx. See [`on_wake` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#on_wake-trigger).

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

default.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: default run duration for timer wakeup and any unspecified wakeup reason.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

gpio_wakeup_reason.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: run duration if woken up by GPIO.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

touch_wakeup_reason.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: run duration if woken up by touch.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

run_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time duration the node should be active, i.e. run code. Only on ESP32, instead of time, it is possible to specify run duration according to the wakeup reason from deep-sleep:

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

sleep_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time duration to stay in deep sleep mode. On BK72xx, the maximum is 36 hours. On Zephyr, the maximum is 49 days.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

touch_wakeup.docs:
**boolean**: Only on ESP32. Use a touch event to wakeup from deep sleep. To be able to wakeup from a touch event, [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/esp32_touch#binary-sensor) must be configured properly.

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

wakeup_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema) / list**: Only on ESP32/BK72xx. A single pin to wake up to once in deep sleep mode. Use the inverted property to wake up to LOW signals. If you want to specify multiple wake-up pins (BK72xx only) specify them under `wakeup_pin` using a list of entries consisting of:

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*

wakeup_pin_mode.docs:
Only on ESP32/BK72xx. Specify how to handle waking up from a `wakeup_pin` if the wakeup pin is already in the state with which it would wake up when attempting to enter deep sleep. See [Wakeup Pin Mode](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#deep_sleep-esp32_wakeup_pin_mode). Defaults to `IGNORE`

*See also: [Deep Sleep Component](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep#configuration-variables)*
